lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Before the throne of God above
I have a strong and perfect plea
A great High Priest whose name is Love
Who ever lives and pleads for me
My name is graven on His hands
My name is written on His heart
I know that while in heav'n He stands
No tongue can bid me thence depart

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: No tongue can bid me thence depart

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: When Satan tempts me to despair
And tells me of the guilt within
Upward I look and see Him there
Who made an end to all my sin
Because the sinless Savior died
My sinful soul is counted free
For God the Just is satisfied
To look on Him and pardon me

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: To look on Him and pardon me

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Behold Him there the risen Lamb
My perfect spotless righteousness
The great unchangeable I AM
The King of glory and of grace
One with Himself; I cannot die
My soul is purchased by His blood
My life is hid with Christ on high
With Christ my Savior and my God

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: One with Himself; I cannot die
My soul is purchased by His blood
My life is hid with Christ on high
With Christ my Savior and my God

lines: With Christ my Savior and my God

candidates.notes: Auto‑generated captions were garbled but clearly followed the three‑verse structure of the reference. Repeated lines identified from the transcript were treated as separate Tag blocks. Where the transcript showed a line repeated (e.g., "No tongue can bid me thence depart" and "To look on Him and pardon me"), a Tag block was added. The later partial repeat of the last four lines of Verse 3 and the final single line were also captured as Tag blocks. All wording follows the reference lyrics; minor differences in the transcript were ignored.
